en.title: Australia Seeks Public Input on NDIS Access Reforms to Improve Disability Support
en.summary: Australians are invited to comment on proposed changes to the National Disability Insurance Scheme access process, aiming for clearer, fairer decisions. Meanwhile, Google's latest Android update reduces motion sickness and enhances accessibility features, while HKIRC promotes an accessible online shopping experience to boost digital inclusion. Advocacy highlights include AbleGamers' Gamescom discussions on gaming accessibility and AARP's guide to accessible hiking trails for people with disabilities.

zh-TW.title: 澳洲公開NDIS無障礙變更諮詢，Android更新增強無障礙功能
zh-TW.summary: 澳洲民眾受邀就國家殘疾保險計畫（NDIS）的無障礙變更提出意見，旨在使申請決策更清晰、公平且一致。同時，Google 最新 Android 更新加入緩解動暈症的功能，減少滑動手機時產生的頭暈感，並加強無障礙功能；HKIRC 推動數碼共融，構建無障礙網購體驗。倡議方面，AbleGamers 在 Gamescom 討論遊戲無障礙，且 AARP 推介無障礙徒步小徑，改善殘障人士戶外體驗。
